name: automation-workflow
architecture: Neural Orchestra v5 Contract-First Vertical Slicing
description: Pipeline for automation, event-driven webhooks, background jobs, and script workflows.

phases.name: Payload Contracts & Event Specifications
phases.instructions: Lock executable event contracts, trigger schemas, and external API interfaces in contracts.ts.

phases.name: Automation Logic & Storage Implementation
phases.instructions: Implement workflow handlers, job queues, and persistent storage. Run node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs locally.

phases.name: Zero-Token Deterministic Quality Gate
phases.instructions: Run node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs. Map failures via orchestra-state.mjs and dispatch back if needed (max 3 retries).

phases.name: Automation Testing & Idempotency Check
phases.instructions: Test webhook payload handling, failure retries, rate limits, and idempotent execution.

phases.name: Deployment & Scheduling
phases.instructions: Deploy background worker containers and schedule recurring cron tasks.
